genre: Cosy mystery in the classic English detective tradition
wishes: Жанр — детектив. Уютная загадка в духе классического английского детектива, без оружия и крови. 3 варианта. (EN: genre detective; a cosy puzzle in the spirit of the classic English detective story, no weapons and no blood; 3 variants. The set title was not given, so the agent chose it.)

variants.concept: The Great Detective: the sleuth's own kit and the London streets of the case
variants.moment: A bright morning in old London, when the great detective takes on a new case and follows its clues across town.

cards.name: Magnifying Glass
cards.subject: A classic detective's magnifying glass: a big round clear glass lens in a thick, polished brass rim, with a chunky turned wooden handle, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; drawn thick and solid so it fills the frame.
cards.unique_detail: through the lens, one footprint of the background pattern looks big and magnified
cards.main_colors: polished brass-gold rim, warm chestnut-brown wooden handle, clear pale glass
cards.background: Rich violet-purple background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a winding trail of small paler-violet footprints across it, centred behind the glass (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The detective's signature tool, recognisable at any size; it opens the set and carries the footprint motif.

cards.name: Deerstalker
cards.subject: A detective's deerstalker cap of soft tweed with one peak at the front and one at the back and two ear flaps tied up on top, resting on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; the tweed checks are big and bold, not fine.
cards.unique_detail: the ear flaps are tied on top with a neat little red ribbon bow
cards.main_colors: caramel-brown and cream tweed checks with a red ribbon
cards.background: Plain fresh green flat surface and a smooth green wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The most famous detective hat; with the magnifying glass it names the genre in two cards.

cards.name: Secret Letter
cards.subject: A sealed old-fashioned paper envelope, thick and slightly puffy as if a secret note is folded inside, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; its flap is closed with a big round wax seal; the envelope is completely blank.
cards.unique_detail: the big glossy red wax seal is stamped with a single footprint
cards.main_colors: creamy ivory paper with a glossy red wax seal
cards.background: Bright sky-blue background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the envelope, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Every classic case begins with a mysterious letter; the footprint on the seal repeats the motif.

cards.name: Case Notes
cards.subject: A detective's small notebook with a cherry-red leather cover, lying open on a polished wooden desk with a soft reflection, a yellow pencil resting across its pages; the pages are blank except for one simple sketch of a footprint, with no words or numbers.
cards.unique_detail: a red ribbon bookmark hanging out of the notebook
cards.main_colors: cherry-red leather cover, cream pages and a bright yellow pencil
cards.background: Polished honey-wood desktop in front of a smooth violet-purple wall with a soft gradient, wall and desk in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The notebook where every clue is written down: a small prop that still says detective.

cards.name: Urgent Call
cards.subject: An old-fashioned candlestick telephone: a tall glossy black stem on a round base with the mouthpiece on top, and a cone-shaped earpiece on a short curly cord, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; drawn chunky and solid.
cards.unique_detail: the earpiece hops off its hook as if the telephone is ringing loudly
cards.main_colors: glossy black with polished brass trim
cards.background: Warm pink background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the telephone, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The call that brings a new case; the tall silhouette contrasts with the flat props, and the playful name tells the story.

cards.name: Fingerprint Kit
cards.subject: A detective's fingerprint kit: a big white card showing one big, bold fingerprint drawn with a few thick swirling lines, with a slim fingerprint dusting brush (soft dark bristles, chunky wooden handle) lying across it and a small open round tin of silver-grey powder beside it; standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; it must not look like a shaving brush in a mug.
cards.unique_detail: a few specks of silver powder dusted over the fingerprint
cards.main_colors: warm brown wooden brush handle with dark bristles, a white card with a dark fingerprint and a silver tin
cards.background: Plain soft violet-purple flat surface and a smooth purple wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: Fingerprints are the best-known clue of detective work; a signature item that needs no explanation.

cards.name: Thinking Chair
cards.subject: A deep, comfy wingback armchair upholstered in glossy bottle-green leather, with big rounded wings and arms and short carved wooden legs, standing on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection; turned slightly in three-quarter view.
cards.unique_detail: a checked deerstalker cap hanging on one wing of the chair
cards.main_colors: glossy bottle-green leather with warm brown wooden legs
cards.background: Polished honey-wood floor and a smooth warm red back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The armchair where the great detective sits and thinks the case through; cosy, and the deerstalker on the wing says whose chair it is.

cards.name: London Cab
cards.subject: A boxy 1930s London taxi cab with a tall rounded roof, big round headlamps, running boards and chunky wheels, parked on a wide band of warm sandy cobblestones; low camera so the cab looks big and heroic, seen in three-quarter view.
cards.unique_detail: a shiny brass bulb horn beside the driver's window
cards.main_colors: glossy black body with cherry-red doors and brass trim
cards.background: A wide band of warm sandy cobblestones across the bottom; behind the cab, a leafy London park with big rounded green trees fills the backdrop up to the top edge; sunny daylight.
cards.why: Hailing a cab to follow the trail across London is a staple of detective stories; the set's vehicle.

cards.name: Townhouse
cards.subject: A tall old London townhouse with a smooth cream-painted front, three rows of big white sash windows with a bay window on the first floor, and a glossy red front door with a half-round fanlight above it and no number, reached by three stone steps with black iron railings at the sides; it is the middle house of a terrace, with the neighbouring houses just peeking in at the left and right edges in paler colours, so it does not stand alone; standing on a wide band of sunny pavement; low camera so the house towers over the viewer.
cards.unique_detail: a trail of small muddy footprints leading up the steps to the door
cards.main_colors: smooth cream stucco with white windows and a glossy red door
cards.background: A wide band of sunny pavement across the bottom and a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds above the house; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The great detective's front door, where clients bring their mysteries; a big place card, and the footprints lead into the finale.

cards.name: Clock Tower
cards.subject: A tall Gothic clock tower of warm cream stone with a big round white clock face that has simple dark marks instead of numbers, and a pointed slate-blue spire roof with gold trim, standing on a wide band of green riverside lawn by a calm river; low camera so the tower soars over the viewer.
cards.unique_detail: a small golden weathervane shaped like a magnifying glass on the tip of the spire
cards.main_colors: warm cream stone with a slate-blue spire and gold trim
cards.background: Golden-hour sunset: a glowing warm orange sky with soft pink clouds behind the tower and a calm river reflecting it; a wide band of green lawn at the bottom; the tower itself stays brightly lit and saturated, never dark or silhouetted.
cards.why: The climax: the case closes as the great clock tower over London glows at sunset; the most iconic London landmark, kept bright.

variants.concept: Country House Weekend: the vanished diamond at the manor
variants.moment: A sunny weekend at an English country manor, where the guests hunt for the family's vanished blue diamond.

cards.name: Manor Key
cards.subject: A big antique key of polished brass with an ornate looped bow, a long sturdy shaft and a chunky toothed bit, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; drawn thick and solid so it fills the frame.
cards.unique_detail: a fluffy red silk tassel tied to the bow of the key
cards.main_colors: polished brass-gold with a red tassel
cards.background: Fresh green background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a scattered pattern of small paler-green keyhole shapes centred behind the key (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The key to a locked room is the first clue of every country-house mystery; the keyhole motif ties it to the set.

cards.name: Tea Time
cards.subject: A round, plump china teapot with a curved spout, a looped handle and a lid with a round knob, standing on a polished wooden tea table with a soft reflection; soft natural semi-transparent steam rises from the spout.
cards.unique_detail: a big painted pink rose on its white belly
cards.main_colors: glossy white china with a big pink rose and gold trim
cards.background: Polished honey-wood tabletop in front of a smooth sky-blue wall with a soft gradient, wall and table in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.context_cue: a small plate with two scones topped with jam and cream beside the teapot
cards.why: Afternoon tea is where the manor's guests trade suspicions: the cosiest moment of a country-house mystery, and a playful name.

cards.name: Butler's Bell
cards.subject: A polished silver hand bell with a wide flared rim and a chunky turned wooden handle, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view as if it is ringing; drawn thick and solid so it fills the frame.
cards.unique_detail: a neat black bow tie wrapped around the handle, like the butler's own
cards.main_colors: polished silver with a dark brown wooden handle and a black bow tie
cards.background: Warm red background with a smooth gradient and a ring of small paler-red keyhole shapes centred behind the bell (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Ring for the butler: the classic country-house suspect, and a wink at 'the butler did it'.

cards.name: Bowler Hat
cards.subject: A classic black bowler hat with a rounded dome crown, a narrow curled brim and a ribbon band, resting on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; smooth felt with a soft satin sheen.
cards.unique_detail: a fresh red carnation tucked into the hatband
cards.main_colors: deep black felt with a red carnation
cards.background: Plain sunny yellow flat surface and a smooth yellow wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.context_cue: a small brass magnifying glass leaning against the hat
cards.why: The hat of the gentleman detective who arrives at the manor; the magnifying glass beside it makes it a sleuth's hat, not just a gentleman's.

cards.name: Hall Clock
cards.subject: A tall grandfather clock of glossy honey-brown wood with a rounded hood, a big round cream clock face with simple dark marks instead of numbers, and a glass door showing a shiny brass pendulum, standing on a polished wooden floor with a soft reflection.
cards.unique_detail: a small brass key left in the lock of its glass door
cards.main_colors: glossy honey-brown wood with brass trim and a cream face
cards.background: Polished light-wood floor and a smooth deep-green back wall with a soft gradient, wall and floor in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The hall clock tells when the diamond vanished, and every alibi hangs on it; a tall shape among the round props.

cards.name: Empty Safe
cards.subject: A sturdy little old-fashioned steel safe, a chunky cube on four short feet, its thick door swung wide open to show an empty inside with only a small royal-blue velvet cushion, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above; a big polished brass dial with simple marks instead of numbers and a brass handle on the door.
cards.unique_detail: the empty velvet cushion inside still shows a little dent where the diamond sat
cards.main_colors: glossy cherry-red steel with gold trim and a polished brass dial
cards.background: Plain sky-blue flat surface and a smooth blue wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The mystery at a glance, with no crime scene and no harm: the safe is open and the diamond is gone.

cards.name: Blue Diamond
cards.subject: A huge sparkling blue diamond, cut in the classic brilliant shape with a few big clear facets, resting on a small plump crimson velvet cushion with gold tassels at its corners; the cushion and the diamond float together with a slight tilt.
cards.unique_detail: one bright star-shaped twinkle on the top facet of the diamond
cards.main_colors: brilliant sapphire-blue diamond on a crimson velvet cushion with gold tassels
cards.background: Warm orange background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the diamond, with a few small paler keyhole shapes among the rays (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The precious object the whole mystery is about; the most iconic prize opens the rare end of the set.

cards.name: Vintage Car
cards.subject: A gleaming 1930s open-top touring car with long curved mudguards, big round chrome headlamps, a tall upright radiator grille and white-wall tyres, parked on a wide band of pale golden gravel drive; low camera so the car looks big and heroic, in three-quarter view.
cards.unique_detail: a leather suitcase strapped to the back, as if the guests have just arrived
cards.main_colors: glossy cream body with cherry-red mudguards and chrome trim
cards.background: A wide band of pale golden gravel across the bottom; behind the car, tall neatly clipped green hedges and round topiary bushes fill the backdrop up to the top edge; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The guests' arrival in a vintage motor car opens every country-house weekend; the set's vehicle.

cards.name: Secret Passage
cards.subject: A tall library bookcase of glossy honey-brown wood holding a few rows of big, chunky books, swung open like a door to reveal a hidden stone staircase going down, which is brightly and warmly lit; it stands on a wide band of polished wooden floor with a red rug; low camera so it looks tall and grand.
cards.unique_detail: one book on the shelf is tilted out like a lever, the one that opened the passage
cards.main_colors: glossy honey-brown wood with books in red, blue and yellow
cards.background: Inside a sunny manor library: a wide band of polished wooden floor across the bottom and a deep-green wall with a tall arched window letting in sunshine filling the backdrop; bright daylight.
cards.why: The hidden passage behind the bookcase is the great reveal of a country-house mystery: suspense without danger.

cards.name: Manor House
cards.subject: A grand English country manor house of warm honey-coloured stone with tall chimneys, rows of big tall white windows, a grand front door with stone steps and a gravel drive leading up to it, standing on a wide band of bright green lawn; low camera so the house looks grand and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a wooden ladder leaning against one open upstairs window, the thief's escape route
cards.main_colors: warm honey-gold stone with white windows and a dark slate roof
cards.background: A wide band of bright green lawn and gravel across the bottom and a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds above the house, with round green trees at the sides; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The climax: the manor itself, where the mystery is solved; the ladder at the open window gives away the culprit's route.

variants.concept: Village Fête: the case of the nibbled prize cake
variants.moment: A sunny summer fête in a sleepy English village, where someone has nibbled the prize-winning cake and the whole village turns sleuth.

cards.name: Bobby Helmet
cards.subject: A classic English police constable's helmet: a tall rounded dome of smooth navy-blue felt with a narrow brim, a shiny silver star badge on the front and a small rounded knob on top, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; drawn chunky and solid.
cards.unique_detail: a little pink daisy tucked behind the silver badge
cards.main_colors: deep navy-blue felt with a shiny silver badge
cards.background: Soft warm pink background with a smooth light-to-deep gradient and a scattered pattern of small paler-pink magnifying-glass shapes centred behind the helmet (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The village constable is on the case: the helmet says English police at a glance.

cards.name: Knitting Basket
cards.subject: A round wicker basket holding a few big soft balls of yarn, with two long wooden knitting needles stuck through a half-knitted pink scarf that hangs over its rim, standing on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above.
cards.unique_detail: a small brass magnifying glass peeking out among the balls of yarn, the knitting sleuth's secret tool
cards.main_colors: honey-gold wicker with pink, lilac and sky-blue yarn
cards.background: Plain sky-blue flat surface and a smooth blue wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: The knitting basket of the village's sharpest amateur sleuth; the magnifying glass in the yarn makes it a detective card, not just a hobby.

cards.name: Strawberry Jam
cards.subject: A chunky glass jar of glossy strawberry jam with a cloth cap of big red-and-white gingham checks tied with string, floating with a slight tilt in three-quarter view; the jam is rich and clearly visible through the clear glass.
cards.unique_detail: one whole shiny strawberry sitting on top of the cloth cap
cards.main_colors: glossy ruby-red jam in clear glass with a red-and-white gingham cap
cards.background: Sunny yellow background with a smooth gradient and a scattered pattern of small paler-yellow magnifying-glass shapes centred behind the jar (the set motif), clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: Homemade jam is the pride of every village fête competition, and the first exhibit in the case.

cards.name: Muddy Wellies
cards.subject: A pair of tall glossy rubber wellington boots standing side by side on a plain flat surface, seen from slightly above, their soles caked with chunky brown garden mud, with a short trail of muddy footprints leading away from them across the surface.
cards.unique_detail: a single pink rose petal stuck to the mud on one boot, a clue from the flower garden
cards.main_colors: glossy bottle-green rubber with chocolate-brown mud
cards.background: Plain soft lilac-purple flat surface and a smooth purple wall gradient behind it, the surface lighter than the wall; no stripes; bright daylight.
cards.why: Muddy boots and footprints are the first real clue of a village mystery: who walked through the flower beds?

cards.name: Missing Slice
cards.subject: A tall round sponge cake of two golden layers filled with thick red jam and white cream and dusted with sugar on top, standing on a white china cake stand on a polished wooden table with a soft reflection; one big slice is missing, leaving a neat triangular gap, with a few crumbs on the stand.
cards.unique_detail: a big blue first-prize rosette pinned to the cake stand
cards.main_colors: golden sponge with red jam and white cream on a white cake stand
cards.background: Polished honey-wood table in front of a smooth warm pink wall with a soft gradient, wall and table in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The case itself: the prize-winning cake with one slice gone. A cosy crime with no harm done, and the playful name tells it.

cards.name: Prize Rose
cards.subject: One big, perfect red rose in full bloom on a short sturdy green stem with two glossy leaves, floating with a slight tilt; the petals are big, smooth and few, so it reads as one chunky shape.
cards.unique_detail: a small blue prize ribbon tied in a bow around the stem
cards.main_colors: velvety red rose with fresh green leaves
cards.background: Sunny yellow background with a smooth gradient and bold radiating light rays centred behind the rose, clearly visible; bright daylight.
cards.why: The prize rose of the flower show, the pride of an English village garden; a soft natural shape among the objects.

cards.name: Constable's Bike
cards.subject: A sturdy old-fashioned black bicycle with a tall upright frame, wide curved handlebars, a big round front lamp, a shiny bell and a wicker basket on the front, standing on its stand on a smooth stone pavement with a soft reflection; seen side-on in slight three-quarter view; drawn chunky, with thick tyres and only a few spokes.
cards.unique_detail: the constable's tall navy-blue helmet sitting in the front basket
cards.main_colors: glossy black frame with navy-blue trim, chrome and a honey-gold wicker basket
cards.background: Smooth sunny stone pavement in front of a plain warm pink wall with a soft gradient, wall and pavement in clearly different tones; no props; bright daylight.
cards.why: The village bobby's bicycle, the slowest and friendliest patrol in England; the set's vehicle and a big signature object.

cards.name: Watermill
cards.subject: An old village watermill with warm honey-coloured stone walls, a red-tiled roof and a big chunky wooden water wheel at its side, turning in a sparkling clear stream that runs across the front past a wide band of green grassy bank; low camera so the mill looks big and heroic.
cards.unique_detail: a little blue front door with a round brass knocker
cards.main_colors: warm honey-gold stone with a red-tiled roof and a brown wooden wheel
cards.background: A wide band of green grassy bank and a clear sparkling stream across the bottom, and a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds above the mill; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The old mill by the stream is a village landmark and a classic hiding place for clues; a big place card with moving water.

cards.name: Village Fête
cards.subject: A long, low rectangular garden-party marquee of white canvas with wide soft-pink stripes, a gently sloped ridge roof and a scalloped edge along the eaves, its long front side open to show a cake stall table with a white cloth inside, a few big triangular bunting flags along the eaves, standing on a wide band of bright green village lawn; low camera so the marquee looks big and festive; it is clearly a village fête tent, not a round circus big top.
cards.unique_detail: a trail of cake crumbs leading out of the open marquee across the grass
cards.main_colors: white canvas with soft pink stripes and yellow bunting
cards.background: A wide band of bright green lawn across the bottom; behind the tent, a row of tall round leafy green trees fills the backdrop up to the top edge; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The summer fête on the village green is where the mystery happens; a big, festive place card.

cards.name: Thatched Cottage
cards.subject: A cosy English cottage with cream walls, a thick rounded golden straw thatched roof, small square windows, a round-topped red front door, a white picket gate and a garden path, standing on a wide band of bright green lawn; low camera so the cottage looks big and welcoming.
cards.unique_detail: a big pink rose bush arching over the front door
cards.main_colors: golden straw thatch and cream walls with pink roses and a red door
cards.background: A wide band of bright green lawn and a garden path across the bottom and a bright open blue sky with a few soft realistic clouds above the cottage; sunny daylight.
cards.why: The climax: the amateur sleuth's rose-covered cottage, where the case of the nibbled cake is solved over tea; the cosiest picture of an English village.
